Hero_Desc_Ui:
The drizzle elemental with her best friend, the frog, Croakie.
Ui always views the world in a positive light and considers all types of adversity or misfortune as insignificant.
With Ui there, even with dark and gloomy skies, there is a strange brightness in the air.
Album_Hate_Ui: Revealing the reality she once concealed.
Album_Ui1: Ui is a drizzle elemental who mounts a strange-looking frog named Croakie, often appearing by lakes and ponds in Elias. Since she's always bright and cheerful, Ui befriends anyone within five minutes of meeting them.
Album_Ui2: I asked Ui where she found her unusually large four-leaf clover. She claimed, she got it by making a wish in a clover field in the forest. It seems that Ui wants to keep its location a secret.
Album_Ui3: On rainy days, Ui takes Croakie to a pond to play as much as Croakie wants. Their bond seems special. When I asked about the decoration on Croakie's mouth, Ui said it's been there since she first met Croakie, and she doesn't know what it is either.
Album_Ui4: It seems that Ui has trouble with phantoms. The reason? Apparently, it's hard to cheer them up or comfort them. Their way of thinking is just too different from the other residents of Elias, making it difficult for Ui to understand them.
Album_Ui5: One day, I saw Ui rush over to console a sprite, who had lost a ring gifted by a friend. When I spoke with that sprite later, she strangely couldn't even remember receiving such a ring. Sprites must have terrible memory.
Album_Ui6: I noticed that some denizens fear Ui and avoid her. Sensing a misunderstanding, I arranged for them to talk things out. The denizens muttered how Ui can be "stuck in her own world." I was worried that things might go wrong, but thanks to her cheerful nature, they quickly cleared things up and became friendly again.
Album_Ui7: Ui once told me that she wishes for the whole world to be happy, just like the memories she treasures. When I asked what those memories were, she fell into deep thought before admitting that she was not really sure.
LoveHero_Ui: Are we going on a picnic? Ui would love that!
LoveHeroCancel_Ui: I had so much fun thanks to you, Master! I'll head back to my pond, now!
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Hate1: Ui smelled the food and panicked, saying it reeked of negative energy.
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Hate2: How bitter was the taste of reality in Ui's cold assessment. It's rare to see such a cold expression on her face.
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Like1: Ui throws the food into the mouth of Croakie, the frog. And it croaks, satisfied.
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Like10: Ui smiled blissfully, saying delicious food had made her happy. She said she could not enjoy it alone and shared some with Eru, after which frog calls echoed through the banquet hall for quite some time.
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Like2: Ui smiles happily, saying the food resembles the food from her memories.
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Like3: Ui says, "It feels like the endless taste of positivity!"... She keeps complimenting it.
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Like4: Watching her take turns with Croakie, as they ate them one by one, was absolutely adorable. It almost like they were playing catch.
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Like5: Ui mentioned feeling envious seeing her Werebeast friends eat this. She was very happy when I gave it to her.
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Like6: Ui empathized, saying she also turns trees into cakes for the Sprites, but that seems like a totally different issue.
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Like7: Ui asked if age could be shared like food. So I gave some of the rice cake soup to Croakie as well.
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Like8: Ui asked if it was a food that makes me happy, so I inadvertently nodded. She then enjoyed the Almond Pralines.
Food_ChefNote_Ui_Like9: Ui was very happy, saying that a variety of positive emotions were welling up inside her. Croakie also seemed happy, crying along joyfully.

LoveCall_Ui:
Hello, Master! It is your friend Ui☆!
Today, Ui came to the pond with Eru!
Looking into its still waters reminded me of the time I came here with you.
Of course, I have visited many times with other friends, but you were the first to come to mind!
Could it be because Ui considers the time spent with you her happiest memories?
Mm-hmm! How about you? Are you happy when you are together with Ui and Eru?
I hope you feel happy every time you are with Ui too!

So even when something becomes difficult, think of Ui and stay strong, Master!
Ui knows that you are always working hard.
Wherever Ui may be, I will always cheer for you!
Hmm? What did you say, Eru? You will cheer for the Master too?
You heard that, right? Both Ui and Eru will support you!
So today, tomorrow, and every day afterward, I hope you remain happy☆!
